deploy-bot: Mirror publish job 'gcr-mirror' skipped for image gcr.io/redwood/inference/api:20260318-1321 (sha256:abc123def...) — attestation timestamp 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z is older than provenance policy (requires >= 2026-01-01).

jordana: saw this in the change-window check. We have a rollforward scheduled in 20m — this will block canary if not resolved. @matt any quick wins?

matt: ugh. pipeline produced attestation with wrong date (CI node clock was off). Can we re-sign the image or should we pin canary back to previous?

olivia: we should avoid skipping attestations for prod. Two options: re-attest the existing image (if we have signer key) or pin canary to previous image sha256:def456 until we re-attest.

sre-oncall: I can re-attest if ops has the staging signer access. Re-attesting will create a new signed manifest; deploybot should accept it once the timestamp is within policy. Takes ~5min.

jordana: plan suggestion: 1) pin canary to sha256:def456 for the scheduled rollforward 2) run re-attest on gcr image in place 3) retry mirror job and resume rollforward 4) add a short release-note entry about the blocked rollforward and fix. Anyone opposed?

matt: LGTM. I'll open a quick PR to update rollout.json to pin canary and trigger a manual resume after we confirm re-attest success.

deploy-bot: Action created: RED-5123 — "re-attest gcr mirror images with corrected timestamp" (assignee: matt). Mirror retry will be attempted after ticket moves to In Progress.

olivia: Matt — when you re-attest, use the cosign command we use in infra: `cosign attest -key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/mirror-signer -predicate predicate.json gcr.io/redwood/inference/api@sha256:abc123def...` — then post the new manifest sha.

matt: copying the command now. will re-run in staging first, then prod.

sre-oncall: FYI, I've bumped an incident label on RED-5123 and added a brief blurb for release notes: "Canary rollforward briefly blocked due to stale image attestation; images re-attested and mirror resumed."

jordana: perfect. after matt confirms re-attest + successful mirror retry, we'll unpin and resume the scheduled rollforward. Thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: re-attest done in staging, new manifest sha256:abc123def... -> re-attested at 2026-03-18T14:35:10Z. kicking off mirror retry now.

deploy-bot: Mirror retry started for gcr.io/redwood/inference/api:20260318-1321.

matt: mirror succeeded. unpinning canary and resuming rollforward.

jordana: closing the loop — rollforward resumed, adding final note to release notes and RED-5123 ticket. thanks everyone.
